name: Accedere Limited
about: Accedere Limited provides compliance audits, technical risk assessments, and cybersecurity consulting services in India. The company offers SOC attest report services, such as SOC 1 type 2 compliance SOC audit; soc 2 compliance audit; SOC reports for CSA STAR/C5; SOC reports for privacy; SOC reports for cyber risk; SOC for supply chain; and statement on standards for attestation engagements no. 21. It also provides US federal, India cert-in, Mena compliance, and Europe compliance assessments; privacy assessment services, including SOC 2 for privacy, US state privacy assessments, GDPR assessments, HIPPA compliance, and data encryption solutions; and cloud security assessments comprising cloud penetration testing, cloud supply chain assessment, cloud container security/kubernetes, and CSA STAR/C5 compliance. In addition, the company offers ISO/IEC certifications; training programs; ESG reporting services; and PQC security services. Further, it provides Controllo to assist organizations in managing cybersecurity governance, risk assessment, and compliance requirements; and drone products under the Freebird name. The company was formerly known as E Com Infotech (India) Limited and changed its name to Accedere Limited in September 2020. Accedere Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.
